purpose: Map Canada as a reportable environmental, infrastructure and decarbonization evidence system while preserving official geography, source provenance, DMRV controls and versioned data/framework assets.

canonical_geography.hierarchy: nation > geographical region > province_or_territory > census_division > census_subdivision > site

reporting_aliases.state: Province or territory (presentation alias only; never stored as the legal administrative type)
reporting_aliases.municipality: Census subdivision where the CSD represents a municipality

canonical_geography.rule: Canonical codes and names come from the selected SGC release. Presentation labels may be simplified, but the canonical administrative type and code are retained.

national_mapping.phase_1: Load official SGC geography and boundary references for all Canada.
national_mapping.phase_2: Resolve province/territory -> census division -> census subdivision relationships.
national_mapping.phase_3: Create representative environmental/infrastructure nodes per region and province/territory.
national_mapping.phase_4: Qualify district and municipality sites for field deployment and project-specific evidence.
national_mapping.phase_5: Attach measured observations, decarbonization projects, infrastructure assets and evidence packages only when source-backed.

municipality_strategy.rule: Municipal reporting rolls upward from CSD to its parent census division, then province/territory, region and nation.
municipality_strategy.municipality_asset: A CSD is a geographic/reporting asset; it is not evidence that a Blue-Ether installation exists.
municipality_strategy.district_asset: A census division is a regional aggregation/reporting asset and may represent a county, regional municipality, regional district or equivalent depending on jurisdiction.

decarbonization_product_strategy.objective: Use Blue-Ether infrastructure to create auditable product development packages for measurable decarbonization and climate-resilience interventions.
product_tracks: infrastructure asset condition and resilience records
decarbonization_product_strategy.product_lifecycle: BASELINE -> PROJECT_BOUNDARY -> ACTIVITY_DATA -> EMISSION_FACTOR_METHOD -> INTERVENTION -> MEASUREMENT -> QA -> RECONCILIATION -> DMRV -> EVIDENCE_ASSET -> VERIFIED_REPORT

assetification.principle: Convert governed observations and framework artifacts into reusable, versioned evidence assets without treating data itself as a financial security or inventing ownership rights.
assetification.relic_definition: A methodology, schema, boundary, calculation rule, source mapping or approved framework version preserved with content hash, effective date, supersession state and provenance.
assetification.rule: Assetification preserves provenance and reproducibility; it does not imply financial valuation, ownership, carbon-credit issuance or regulatory approval.

dmrv_sequence: SOURCE -> OBSERVATION -> QA -> RECONCILIATION -> CANONICAL EVIDENCE PACKAGE -> SHA-256 ROOT -> SUPPORTED NETWORK ANCHOR -> VERIFICATION REGISTRY
infrastructure_role: The same Blue-Ether evidence infrastructure is reused for geographic intelligence, environmental monitoring, GHG/ESG reporting, infrastructure records, project measurement and investor/public reporting.
funding_boundary: Grant, procurement, municipal partnership and institutional funding packages are mapped to measurable geography, asset coverage, indicator coverage, evidence quality and deployment milestones. No token or speculative financing assumption is required.
source_policy: Official Canadian geographic/statistical sources establish the geography layer. Environmental, infrastructure, emissions and meteorological providers are separately registered and their claims remain source-specific.
